title: SSRIs that made him suicidal; his psychiatrist quit

tellings.quote: then they put me on those meds that made me suicidal and that's why my first doctor quit.

plain: Around 2016 and 2017, doctors at the VA, the US government health service for military veterans, put a man named Dylan Borland on antidepressants called SSRIs, and he says they made him suicidal. He tells it himself, pointing to his VA medical records, and says that is the reason his first doctor quit his case.
